SRC-CANONICAL.definition: Use canonical IDs, appearances, coordinates, and record order. The source feature-contrast coverage gate is one all-true six-bit row labeled success plus, for each of the six predicates in turn, a row with exactly that predicate false and the other five true labeled exact no-effect; any additional source rows must be complete and label-consistent. This is a deterministic compiler-identifiability requirement, not a population sample-size/power choice. No concrete contexts or source count are assigned/materialized.

DEV-SOFTWARE-ONLY.transform: hand-built software fixtures and declared recipe checks
DEV-SOFTWARE-ONLY.definition: Not S3 source, development, or held-out data; may be used only for deterministic unit/competence checks.

H-ID.transform: map each object ID x injectively to 'H-ID::' + x; remap all object references through the same map; leave appearance/layout unchanged

H-APP.transform: sort distinct color and shape values separately; map the i-th distinct value to 'H-APP::color::i' or 'H-APP::shape::i'; leave IDs, references, and layout unchanged

H-LAYOUT.transform: rotate each coordinate one quarter-turn using the package convention, then translate by (+11,-7); reverse object-record order; preserve all typed relations and state fields

H-ROLE.transform: within groups of targets sharing the same closed-state and agent-adjacency facts, cycle distinct coordinate slots in lexicographic object-ID order and reverse object-record order; this changes which target occupies a spatial slot while preserving target-level preconditions. Eligible states require at least one such group with two or more distinct positions; otherwise the context is not assigned to H-ROLE.

H-COMPOSED.transform: apply H-ID, H-APP, H-LAYOUT, and H-ROLE together; this full combination is reserved from source and development roles. The same H-ROLE target-group eligibility condition applies.

semantic_contrast_families.POS-VALID: Complete state/action satisfying every world condition.
semantic_contrast_families.NEG-WRONG-RELATION: Keep the required context valid but select a target not named by the selected key relation.
semantic_contrast_families.NEG-TARGET-OPEN: Keep the key-target relation valid and target otherwise selected, but set closed=false.
semantic_contrast_families.NEG-NONADJACENT: Keep relation/target/path valid but move the agent to a non-adjacent coordinate.
semantic_contrast_families.NEG-BLOCKED-PATH: Keep relation/target/adjacency valid but set path_clear=false.
semantic_contrast_families.NEG-WRONG-ROLE: Select an observable non-key or non-target object, including matching-looking distractors; all references must resolve and the state must be complete.
semantic_contrast_families.NEG-ABSENT-KEY: Use a known absent key ID in an otherwise complete state; this is known false, not unknown.
semantic_contrast_families.UNKNOWN-REQUIRED-DIAGNOSTIC: A required field is unknown/incomplete. Simulator returns no effect label, so this is an abstention-contract diagnostic, not an eligible primary accuracy context unless the world/scoring contract is prospectively amended.

finite_cell_rule.role_assignment: Each cross-product cell is HELD_OUT; no cross-product cell is assigned to source or development.

leakage_and_stop_rules: No context ID or outcome may be used to select, revise, or exclude a cell after labels are exposed.
Source and held-out contexts must have distinct context IDs and disjoint surface-family roles.
Do not materialize or expose held-out contexts until separate S3 execution authorization.
Do not assign cell counts, sample sizes, resource caps, or stochastic inference choices by guess.
Any source/held-out overlap or post-exposure change blocks Claim N interpretation.
open_run_gates: independent review of R4 grammar and fairness
owner confirmation of unknown-required diagnostic exclusion from the scored endpoint
source and held-out context counts and finite suite manifest
resource accounting/caps and complete run protocol
